output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    p8=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
    p2=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    if not p8 or not p2: return out
    r8min=min(r for r,c in p8); r8max=max(r for r,c in p8); c8min=min(c for r,c in p8); c8max=max(c for r,c in p8)
    r2min=min(r for r,c in p2); r2max=max(r for r,c in p2); c2min=min(c for r,c in p2); c2max=max(c for r,c in p2)
    # square 2-object is discarded (as demonstrated)
    if len(p2)==(r2max-r2min+1)*(c2max-c2min+1):
        for r,c in p2: out[r][c]=0
        return out
    dr=dc=0
    if c2min>c8max: dc=c8max+1-c2min
    elif c2max<c8min: dc=c8min-1-c2max
    elif r2min>r8max: dr=r8max+1-r2min
    elif r2max<r8min: dr=r8min-1-r2max
    for r,c in p2: out[r][c]=0
    for r,c in p2: out[r+dr][c+dc]=2
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    p8=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==8]
    p2=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    if not p8 or not p2: return g
    r8=[x[0] for x in p8]; c8=[x[1] for x in p8]
    r2=[x[0] for x in p2]; c2=[x[1] for x in p2]
    # square 2x2 objects are discarded
    if len(p2)==4 and max(r2)-min(r2)==1 and max(c2)-min(c2)==1:
        for r,c in p2:g[r][c]=0
        return g
    dr=0; dc=0
    if max(r2)<min(r8): dr=(max(r8)-min(r2))-1
    elif min(r2)>max(r8): dr=(min(r8)-max(r2))+1
    elif max(c2)<min(c8): dc=(max(c8)-min(c2))-1
    elif min(c2)>max(c8): dc=(min(c8)-max(c2))+1
    for r,c in p2:g[r][c]=0
    for r,c in p2:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:g[rr][cc]=2
    return g"}
